'''Rinn''' was a backwater [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Tintinna/Legends|Tintinna]].

==Description==
Rinn was a primitive, little-known, and rarely visited world located in the Outer Rim. Its native [[Species/Legends|species]] was called [[Tintinna/Legends|Tintinna]], also known as Tin-Tin Dwarves. Tintinna lived in underground burrows and, without outside help, their technology advanced to the point of steam power. Because of its remote location, Rinn was appreciated by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] as a hiding place.<ref name="TEGtAS" />

==History==
Rinn was a long-established [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located near [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. Histories of the planet talked about the ancient [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], previous to their [[Hutt Cataclysms|civil war]], with horror and fear.<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

The planet Rinn remained neutral during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="FF139">{{FactFile|139|WOR 1-2|Worlds of the Clone Wars}}</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[X-7]] hired a team of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to kill [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] on [[Iope]], one of the moons of Rinn.<ref name="RF:F" />
